budgets: Hive frontend proposed acceptance budgets (measure, do not assert): first meaningful overview from a valid local snapshot <=1.5s p95; pointer/keyboard selection feedback <=100ms p95; filtered scene projection <=16ms p95 for 14 attempts/500 retained marks; idle foreground CPU bounded and no 60Hz server polling; no sustained memory leak over 30-minute reconnect; full scene DOM <=500 normal nodes with aggregation; no more than 200 recent marks in synoptic view. If server query is slower, show an honest loading/stale state rather than fake completeness. Test on Windows/Chromium, Linux/Chromium, a real Orbit sandboxed pane and narrow/mobile layouts.
